card.title: HENSCHEL HS 123
card.flavorText: The Henschel Hs 123 was a single-seat biplane dive bomber first used by the German Luftwaffe during the Spanish Civil War, and although the production was stopped in 1940, it was used up until 1944, but then it was pulled from the frontline and assigned to secondary duties such as conducting supply drops and glider towing.
